tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha khang chen mo na bzhugs pa'i sa skya pa chen po'i gser sku sku tshad ma mthong ba don ldan dang / 'od dpag med kyi gser sku dgos 'dod kun 'byung gnyis kyi gzungs gzhug sogs kyi dkar chag dpyod ldan yid 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// shrī ā yu de wa ma sha ra ṇi gatstsha mi/ dpal tshe'i lha la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dir gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang rnams kyi gtsug rgyan sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo na bzhugs su gsol ba'i rje sa skya pa chen po dang / 'od dpag med kyi gser sku ngo mtshar can 'di gnyis ni/ sa skya pa chos med sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ rang gi rigs las skyes pa'i dge bsnyen ma kun dga' chos kyi nyi ma dang / rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i grogs mchog dam pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer gyi don du gsar du bzhengs pa'i sku brnyan 'di gnyis kyi gzungs rdzongs bzhugs tshul la gnyis ka la 'dra bar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi mtshan sngags/ mdo sngags kyi yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi gzungs sngags/ chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi sngags spel tshig so so gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i stod smad bar gsum gyi gzungs rnams tshang bar bzhugs shing / gzhan yang rgya gar gyi paṇa grub mang po dang / sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma lnga nas bzung / sngags 'chang yab sras dang / rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma so so'i bar du byon pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi dbu lo kun 'dus/ gdung rus kun 'dus/ na bza' kun 'dus kyi thum bum che ba re re dang / kha che paṇa chen gyi rgya gar gyi byin rlabs rten thams cad bsdus pa'i rten 'dam la/ chos rje sa paṇa dang sngags 'chang chen pos bod kyi byin rlabs kyi rten mtha' dag bsre bar mdzad pa'i rten 'dam dpe bral mar grags pa la gzhi byas/

slar nged rang gis kyang byin rlabs kyi rten mang du bsres pa'i rten 'di la btab pa'i tsha tsha gser dngul gyi na bza' can grangs mang ba re dang / sa chen gyi sku la lhag por yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung gsum/ glo bo mkhan chen gyi phyag nas bzhugs pa'i rje brtse ba chen po'i sku rkang gang pa gcig sngags 'chang chen pos sku tshe hril por rgyun bzhes mdzad pa'i sku bems phyi sle'u sngo khra nang bcas dri bzang khyad par can 'thul ba bub ma nyams pa/ mkhan chen kun bkras pas bzhengs pa'i sngags 'chang chen po gtso bo la lam zab brgyud pa yongs rdzogs/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ mkhan chen dpal ldan bzang po/ sbyin bdag mkhan chen kun bkras/ yi dam dges rdor/ bde mchog gshed dmar/ chos skyong gur zhal lha mo/ nor lha dzam dmar sogs bzhugs pa'i bris thang che ba la sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs pa gcig ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis phyag nas mdzad pa'i bris thang gtso bo sa chen che ba la/ lam 'bras lam bskor kyai rdor 'grel lugs dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa/ yi dam zhi khro chos skyong nor lha sogs 'dod lha mang pos bskor ba'i bris thang gcig mtho mthing gser gyi lha khang nas spyan drangs pa'i lo chen rin bzang gi phyag nas thugs dam ma yin nges gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi dkyil thang bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa bal ris ma gcig ngor chen yab sras gnyis kyi phyag nas bzhugs pa'i bde mchog lo hi pa dang / kyai rdor man ngag lugs lha dgu/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa rnams kyi dkyil thang bla ma brgyud pa yi dam zhi khro/ chos skyong nor lha sogs kyis bskor ba re re/ stong ra chos rje kun dga' legs grub kyi thugs dam phyag nas ma mgon po lha bcu gnyis ma'i dkyil thang bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba gcig rnams bzhugs shing / gzhan yang tshe dpag med dang 'od dpag med/

thub dbang sogs kyi gser sku byin rlabs can mang ba dang / gsung rab bzhugs pa la/ kyai rdor rgyud gsum gong ma'i mchan bcas/ gsang 'dus sgron gsal/ dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od sogs po ti lnga phrag gcig dang gnyis kyis lhag pa tsam bzhugs shing // ༈ //'od dpag med kyi sku la lhag por sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung lnga/ rje btsun grags pa'i ring bsrel/ bu ston rin po che'i ring bsrel rnams dang / thub pa'i dbang po/ tshe dpag med/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams kyi gser sku chos rje lo phu ba chos rin gyi thugs dam ma byin rlabs can/ bris thang bzhugs pa la/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras rnams byas 'gyur du dbyar gzigs la phebs dus kyi bkod pa dang mthun par sngags 'chang nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa can dge slong kun dga' don grub kyis bzhengs pa'i bris thang gzim gur gyi nang na sngags 'chang chen po'i sku che ba la gdung sras sku mched sbyin bdag dang bcas pas bskor ba'i steng na/ yi dam kyai rdor/ bde mchog gur drag chos skyong gur zhal dang bcas yod pa la sngags 'chang nyid kyi phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub nyid kyi phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs nges pa nged rang la e waṃ bla brang nas byung pa'i bris thang gtso bo rje dkon mchog lhun grub nyid la bde kyai gnyis kyi bla ma brgyud pa yongs rdzogs/ yi dam chos skyong nor lha sogs kyis bskor ba byin rlabs can gcig yang kyai rdor lha dgu dang / gur mgon gyi dkyil thang gong ma'i phyag nas ma re re/ rje tshar chen gyi bris sku phyag nas ma rje nyid kyi gzigs snang ma'i bram gzugs dang mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu sogs kyis bskor ba gcig mnga' ris chos rgyal gong ma'i gzim chung bris thang khrod nas byung ba'i tshe dpag med gser thang byin rlabs can gcig dang /

gnas rab 'byams pa'i thugs dam ma yin nges kyi tshe dpag med kyi gser thang gcig ste de gnyis la tshe dpag med kyi sku che chung 'dres pa nyis brgya dang sum cu so bdun yod pa/ gsung rab kyang kyai rdor rgyud gsum gong mchan ma sogs glegs bam byin rlabs can 'ga' zhig bzhugs shing / yang bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi 'od dpag med kyi bris thang che legs byin rlabs can gcig sgrol dkar tshe sbyin ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bris sku tshe'i 'khor lo sngags 'phreng 'od skor mang po dang bcas pas bskor ba tshe khrid dang mthun pa la/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags dgung lo brgya cu gya dgu pa'i phyag nas ma thugs dam gyi rten yun ring mdzad pa rten 'brel legs cha can rnams bzhugs shing / de ltar sa skya pa chen po dang 'od dpag med kyi sku 'di gnyis sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can rang lo nga gnyis dang nga gsum lon pa'i byi glang gnyis kyi lo ngo la gegs med du legs par grub nas/ nged rang rdo rje 'dzin pa dpon slob bcu phrag lhag tsam gyis rab tu gnas pa yang smin rgyas su bgyis pa lags/ rten bzhengs 'dis mtshon pa'i rang gis dge ba ci byas rnams rang la blo gtad kyi shi gson rnams kyi don du bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs kha zhe med par rgyun du bgyis pa la phan yon cung zad yod par sems te/ dge bsnyen ma de nyid 'das nas ring por ma lon pa'i rmi lam du/ gdan sa'i shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' la 'ja' sprin sna tshogs pa bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi ri mo yod pa/ shing sdong chen po'i gzugs 'dra ba zhig shar byung pa la/ ngo mtshar che snyam yang yang bltas pas/ de je gsal gyi ngang nas de'i khrod nas 'ja' lus kyi rnam pa can zhig khang thog tu babs byung nas/ sngar mthong ma myong ba'i gar sna tshogs bsgyur ba sogs legs gzo'i rnam pa byed pa zhig byung bas/

de 'phral gnyid sad byung pa'i yid snang la dmigs yul dge bsnyen ma kun dga' chos kyi nyi ma de nyid mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing sogs gnas mthon po zhig tu skyes pa la the tshom mi dgos pa 'dug snyam rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la dad pa gong 'phel dang blo bde ba yang tshad med pa byung ba yin zhing / de bzhin du nged rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i rab 'byams smra ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams 'od zer de nyid/ rang lo bco brgyad lon tsam nas bzung nged rang la blo gtad kyi yul chig bsgril du bgyis shing / de nas rang nyid lo nyer gcig lon pa nas brtsams lag g.yog gi mthil bzhugs 'gan khur byas nas bzung ste/ rang nyid gsung rab kyi blta rtog dang 'chad nyan kha 'don sogs gtso bor byas chog pa'i/ 'phral gyi lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las skyong lugs kyi bya ba che phra kun la bzang khag ngan khag thams cad khur/ gzhan gyi dngos po ster byin byung ba kun yang nged la rgyus med pa gcig kyang med cing / bzang gra 'bring gra thams cad nged rang gi lag tu thim pa byas/ gos zan sogs 'phral gyi nyer mkho'i rigs gang sbyin yang 'thebs su mi len par/ khyed rang khams bzang phyin lto gos ma 'phongs tsam 'di khas ma chog pa'i/ bla ma'i phyag rdzas la mos rnogs byas pas/ rang gzhan kun brlag pa'i rgyur 'gyur zer mi len/ nan bskyed byas pas thengs gcig blangs yang slar bskyal yong ba sogs/ deng sang gi mi rnams kyi bsam sbyor dang ye mi mthun pa zhig yod cing / rang dang mthun mi mthun ci ltar yang gong gi zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba zhig yod na khong yangs kyi bskur skyong byed lugs kun gyi mig ltos la phan par byed cing / don med kyi bsam ngan su la yang mi 'chang / gnyen bshes dang nye 'brel kun la'ang nged kyi ched du 'thab pa dang 'dzings pa kho na byed pas/ so so nas thugs mnyes rgyu med pa'i ngang la 'gro ba sogs mdor na bsam rgyu nged rang las med cing blo sems gcig tu 'dres pa'i/

rang ngos nas lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las gang skyong yang med thabs med pa'i skad cig kyang 'bral thabs med pa'i grogs shig yin yang / dus ngan gyi dbang gis me mo phag lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i skabs tsam la dge 'brug thug pa'i dus zing khyon chen langs par brten/ rang ngos nas bstan 'gro la phan re'i bsam pa gang ches dpon slob rags bsdus shig gis lho rong du chings don la shar stabs su phyin pas/ so so nas dgongs spangs mtho ba'i stabs/ don 'khyol mngon 'gyur che ba ma byung yang / nged rang sgar thog tu bslebs pa tsam gyis phan tshun gnyis thad du dbyings kyi phan sleb che ba byung 'dug cing / lhag par bod dmag bros dus dmag mi nyes med lnga brgya lhag tsam gyi srog skyob thub pa sogs/ gzhan phan ming btags tsam byung ba'i snyan grags la brten/ nged la dog cha che ba yod pa de dpon slob sems yid dag pas dog de khur ba'i rnam pas/ rang gi nye 'khor gyi gtso bo de nyid glo bur gyi rkyen 'dra ba'i nad kyis zin nas 'da' bar nye ba na/ gzhan thabs byed rgyu ni ma rnyed/ sangs rgyas dang bla ma gong ma'i 'phel gdung gsum gyis gtsos/ rje btsun gong ma'i dbu skra kun 'dus/ gdung rus kun 'dus/ theg chen spur sha stobs che ba/ sngags 'chang chen po'i dam rdzas ril bu mang ba sogs myong grol gyi byin rlabs mtha' dag nged rang gi lag bdar nas byin cing / rang re gnyis phan tshun gcig gis gcig kho na bsam pa yin pas/ da lam bya ba khams chen rang la mi thug tsam yong las che/ ci ste thug kyang rjes kyi bya ba gang spyi thams cad ngos rang nas 'gan khur dkon mchog thugs zhe mi 'khrol ba byed cing / khyed rang rgyun du sems la brjed med kyis phyi ma mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du 'phrad pa'i smon lam 'debs so byas pas/ bka' drin che yang yang zer zhing blo kha rdzogs pa'i lugs byas song pa tsam blo bde ba byung /

de nas dpon slob phan tshun mgo dang lag pa sbrel pa'i dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i smon lam brgya phrag lnga tsam yid tshim par btab cing / rnal 'byor ma'i sngags oṃ gsum ma 'phreng skor lhag tsam gyi bar/ mkha' spyod ma'i 'pho ba gsal 'debs byas pas/ zla ba dang po'i nyer bzhi'i nyi ma phyed yol la 'das song pas/ de 'phral nas bzung rus bu'i rtsar nged rang gi ban gtsang pa rnams kyis ltung bshags brgyad brgya drug cu/ bzang spyod brgyad brgya bzhi/ 'di nas nying mtshams stong phrag brgyad dang brgyad brgya lhag tsam rnams mtshan gang hril po dang / nyer lnga'i nyi ma snga phyed lhag tsam bgyis pas/ de mtshams rus pa'i spyi gtsug gi sha lpags 'phar zhing skra gzengs pa'i gseb nas chu ser dmar phrul le ba dang bcas rtags byung par brten/ de 'phral rus chog tshul bzhin byas nas/ slar nged rang gis sreg chog byed bsam gdan sar skyel mi btang zhing / de nas nged rang ban gtsang pa dang bcas pas nyer lnga'i dgong dang / bdun tshigs gnyis kyi bar du kun rig la brten pa'i lam ston smin rgyas byas pa dang / lho rong dang phag rir bdun phrag gnyis kyi bar la/ dpon slob rnams kyis rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod tshar bcu dgu bgyis pa la oṃ gsum ma 'bum gter gcig dang / khri tsho gcig stong phrag bzhi rnams song zhing / de nas nged rang rnams gdan sar ma sleb bar la dpon slob rnams kyis bzang spyod stong ra can dang / 'di nas nying mtshams ma/ chos skyong rnams la dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i 'phrin 'chol khri ra can lhag tsam dang / sa skyar bdun tshigs dang po'i steng du tshogs chen gyi cho ga de nas nyin gsum bar la bzang spyod 'bum gter bsgrubs rjes/ mkhan chen dang bcas pa'i bla ma bum 'dzin/ dge 'dun rags bsdus shig gis kun rig gi cho ga lam ston dang bcas pa stong tshar lhag tsam 'gro nges dang / de bar la sa skya'i lha khang mgon khang rags bsdus rnams su dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam/

'phrin bcol stong ra khri ra sogs bsgrubs shing / zhe dgu'i bar gyi bdun tshigs phal cher la dgon pa che phra mang por mang skol sogs btang pa'i smon lam 'gro gang che dang / lhag par rin chen gling du gser srang gang gzhi rten du sprad pa'i bzang spyod 'bum gter song nges dang / gzhan yang sa skya'i chos sde lho byang / gling kha tshogs chen/ bskyed lhas sogs su lo 'khor mar nyer lnga byung re bzhin/ 'byams tshugs/ mang ja sogs kyi thog sman bla'i mchod chog ltung bshags bzang spyod sogs 'gro che ba rang bgyis pa dang / bde ba can gyi zhing bkod mang po yod pa'i kun rig gi dkyil thang che ba/ sman bla'i dkyil thang sogs bris thang mang ba/ gong du bkod pa bzhin 'od dpag med kyi gser sku mi tshad la nye ba gzungs gzhug khyad par can mang du bzhugs pa dang / sngon sngags 'chang chen po'i sku 'khor dge slong rin chen rnam pa la gnang ba ltar/ bde mchog pho brang gi nye logs su mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa gsar du bzhengs te/ 'di la yang gzungs rdzongs stod smad bar gyi gzungs sngags rnams cha tshang ba dang / 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod sogs bris thang byin rlabs can 'ga' re dang / thub dbang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma sogs kyi gser sku mang ba/ gsung rab glegs bam gyi tshogs du ma/ lhag par grogs mchog dam pa de'i phung po ma nyams pa sa skyar bslebs pa la kyai rdor man ngag lugs la brten pa'i sbyin sreg byas/ rus bu la sa tsha btab pa'i grangs la/ 'jam dbyangs bcu bdun/ tshe dpag med sum brgya dang bdun/ gong ma lnga tshar lnga/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum rje mus chen dang bcas pa lnga tshar/ mi 'khrugs pa lnga bcu/ 'od dpag med brgya dang bcu rnams gzungs dang bcas pa nged rang gis lag brdar nas btab pa rnams gzungs su bcug pa la rab gnas smin rgyas byas pa sogs kun gyis mngon gsal de bzhin yin pa/

gang ltar snying po 'das po de nyid rang gi lhag bsam dang / gong bkod kyi dge ba rnams kyi stobs dang / nged rang gis skad cig kyang brjed med kyis bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pa'i nus mthus/ dmigs yul de nyid thog mar mkha' spyod/ de nas bde ba can du skyes nas slar yang sa skya pa'i zhabs tog sgrub pa'i phyir du nged rang gi chos gzhis khongs su sprul pa'i skye ba zhig 'byung ba'i rtags mtshan thugs dam pa bzang po mang po'i rmi ltas dang / sgo rum dang gzur khang du nged rang gis brtag pa byas pa'i 'bab lugs/ chos skyong chen po'i lung bstan sogs mtshungs par byung pa yin te/ de yang thog mar lho rong du cho 'phrul zla ba'i nyer lnga'i nyin rtags byung 'phral/ nged rang gis kun rig la brten pa'i lam ston smin rgyas shig byas pas/ de'i nub mo rmi lam du sa skya'i sgo rum mgon khang gi steng na khye'u mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam skye mched gtsang ba g.yu'i zur phud can zhig phar yul tshur yul byed kyin 'dug pa'i mod la/ de 'phral bzhi thog bla brang gi mkha' spyod gzim chung du rab 'byams pa de dang 'phrad byung nas rang dang nye bar gcar gcar byas byung bas/ lag pa la bcang bcang 'jus pas drung ram pa rnal 'byor ma sgoms rnal 'byor ma sgoms zhes nyis btud du smras pas/ dga' ba'i tshul gyis dar phon kha dog mang po can zhig nged kyis bskyed pa'i bsnyen phur la bskon byung ba/ lan cig tshar song ba slar yang bskon byung zhing / 'bog cig khyer 'dug pa ci yin dris pas/ mkhan chen gshegs pa de'i yin zer byung ba khong rang tsho mkha' spyod du 'phrad pa'i rtags yin pa 'dra/ de'i nye 'khor na rnam rgyal dang tshe dbang gnyis kyang 'dug pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rgyal nas tshe dbang ba'i mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gyi go 'phang thob zer ba'i brdar 'dug snyam pa gnyid sad 'phral yid snang la shar byung bas/

gong bkod ltar rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod la chig sgril byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de lags/ de nas phag rir bslebs nas kyang lam ston smin rgyas thengs gnyis byas pas/ tshes brgyad kyi nub rmi lam du sa skya'i chu mig rdzing kha'i sngags 'chang chen po'i gzim chung bde ba can na gdan bzang po la nged rang dpon slob gnyis 'dug pa'i mdun na/ nas dkar mo bre gang tsam dang / rmug mo yol gang tsam zhig 'dug pa dmigs yul de'i sgrib pa phal cher dag cing / da dung cung zad sbyong rgyu yod pa'i rtags dang / yang rang re dpon slob 'di 'dra rang gi dga' ba skyid pa blo bde ba'i tshad du 'dug zer zhing / bde nyams dpag med byed pa zhig byung ba/ de dus bla ma rnams kyi thugs rjes mkha' spyod dbang mo dang chos skyong rnams kyis rig 'dzin mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub gnang nas bde ba can du padma'i sbubs su/ skad cig bskal par snang ba sgyu ma'i dpe tshul gyi/ gzhan stobs kyi dbang gis sgrib pa'i lhag ma rnams yud kyis byang bar gyur nas/ gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pas gzhan don bya nus pa'i gtan du bde ba'i mdun ma zin pa 'dra snyam pa gnyid sad pa'i sems snang la shar byung bas blo bde ba la tshad med pa byung zhing / yang de dus skabs shig nged rang dpon slob mang po sa skya'i nub phyogs kyi ri yin snyam pa'i mthon po zhig la bzhon pa dang bcas dka' las chen pos 'dzeg gin 'dug pa/ ri rtser sleb nye ba na ngal gso zhing ri rtse brgal ba na gnas nyams dga' ba zhig yod snyam/ sngon gyi bag chags kyis rang gi mda'u rnams la nged rang gi rab 'byams pas rjes ma zin byung gar song byas pas/ de rnams na re/ khong khyed rang gi sngon la nyams dga' mo der byon zin pa yin zer byung ba dang / gnyid sad byung bas/ 'di yang sngar gyi rmi lam dang sgo mthun zhing / sngon rje btsun rin po che'i rnam thar mnal lam mar bshad pa dang yang cha 'dra bar 'dug snyam pa shar/

yang de dus rang gi nye 'khor skya ser rtsa gsal ba gnyis la dkon mchog chos skyong la nged rang gis dmod nas smin rgyas byas pa re gtad nas/ gar skyes rmi lam sgug tu bcug pas/ gcig la sa skya'i bkra shis lha khang na 'cham mgon lcam dral rnams bande mang po'i rol mo dang bcas 'chams kyi 'dug pa'i khrod nas lha mo zhig gar 'chams shin tu brel ba dang bcas pa'i ngang nas/ mi gcig na re drung ram legs ni mkha' spyod la phebs song ltos dang zer/ bltas pas jo mo thang ra ma'i thad nas lho phyogs kyi nam mkha' mthon por sprin dkar ba sang dud btang pa ltar skya re ba'i steng na yar gos rgyan bzang pos brgyan te shar phyogs su gdong pa log byas nas 'dzum mu le ba dang bcas thegs song pa byung 'dug cing / 'di dang mthun pa nged rang la de dus lha mo dmag zor ma 'dis rtsa mi bde ba sogs rtsub 'gyur du ma bstan byung bas bskang bshag smin rgyas shig byas pas rtsub 'gyur rnams zhi song pa/ de yang las sgrub pa'i yus kyi rnam par snang zhing / yang gcig gi rmi lam du sa skya'i bde chen gling gi bo gdong bla ma rig 'dzin pa'i khang pa na rab 'byams pa de rig 'dzin nam sleb bar mtshams byas yod zer/ sgo 'gram na khyi nag po chen po gnyis dang bcas 'dug pa byung snang ba/ 'di yang chos skyong gur zhal gnyis kyi 'phrin las la brten nas bde ba can du padma'i sbubs su rig 'dzin gyi spangs rtogs rnams mthar phyin par byed pa'i rtags su 'dug snyam pa shar nas/ slar yang de bzhin yin tshe dmigs ltas bzang po ston cig pa'i dmod nas dang bcas sgug tu bcug pas/ yang rab 'byams pa de nyid gdal chu'i chu kha na grogs mang pos lus la khrus dag par byed pa zhig byung 'dug pa sngar gyi rtags de de bzhin yin pa la the tshom mi dgos pa 'dra zhing / sa skyar slebs 'phral sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i drung du gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab nas/

mkha' spyod go 'phang thob ma thob/ bde ba can du skyes ma skyes/ yang yol mo sprul sku'i lung bstan bzhin/ da dung skye ba lnga drug tsam len dgos mi dgos/ yang skye ba gsum tsam nas dag pa'i zhing du skye mi skye rnams zan ril bsgril bas/ mkha' spyod thob pa dang / bde ba can du skyes pa'i zan ril gnyis dus gcig la pang du bab/ gzhan rnams ma thon byung bas/ da ni sngar gyi rtags rnams dang mthun byung pas gdeng khel du 'dug snyam de nub nas gnyid khugs pa lta bu'i lus sems bde 'bol gyis song ba zhig byung ba/ bla ma dkon mchog la blo 'khel na mi bslu ba'i nges shes skyes pa dga' ba la ang / da dung 'bral med du thugs rje gzigs shing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gzhan yang mus mdog shab stod rnams kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs rmi lam zin cing sbyong spel sprul sgyur nus pa dang / 'od gsal gyi nyams rtogs shar nges pa lnga tsam la dmigs yul de gar skyes brtag tu bcug pas/ gcig la ni sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i drung du nged rang dpon slob a tsa ra gnyis dang bcas dar yug ljang khu la mdud pa byed cing 'dug pa'i mod la/ dbu rtse rnying mar sngar med pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i sku dang rnal 'byor ma'i sku zhig 'dug pa la rab 'byams pa des rten bshad byed pa'i ngang la/ gong bzhugs kha'u skyed lhas nas phebs byung zer dmigs yul de mgyogs par bzhi thog tu zhugs song ba zhig byung 'dug pa 'di yang / mkha' spyod rig 'dzin go 'phang thob nas/ slar yang sprul pa'i skye ba zhig kha'u phyogs su len pa'i snga ltas yin pa 'dra zhing / yang gcig la ni/ 'di'i ched du dkon mchog la gsol 'debs kyi mtshams bsdams pa'i zhag lnga song ba'i tho rangs nyams dang rmi lam 'dres par/ bud med rgya mo 'dra ba dar gyi gos brtsegs mang po gyon pa/ skra sil bur byas pa zhig mdun du byung bas/

'di mkha' 'gro mar 'dug snyam phyag mdzod de gang na yod ces dris pas/ mkha' spyod mkha' spyod zer ba'i gsung shin tu che ba gnyis dang / rig 'dzin rig 'dzin zer gsung chung ba gnyis gsungs nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song bas snang ba thams cad nyams snang 'ba' zhig tu bun long 'gro ba dang bcas de'i nyin gang sems bde stong du gnas pa dang / slar yang brtags pas chos ldan gyi skye ba zhig 'phral du yong tshul byung 'dug cing / yang gcig la ni nyams rtags ngo mtshar can mang po byung ba'i mthar/ myur du skye ba sprul sku ston/ /zer ba byung 'dug pa dang / de bzhin du nged rang lho rong nas 'khor 'phral/ chos skyong chen por yus dang bcas pas/ nged kyi zla bo de mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du skye nges pa'i las mdzad dgos pa'i 'phrin bcol gyi yi ge btang ba'i lan du/ chos skyong rang gi gsung shog dang / de'i gsal byed mkhan tshangs pa'i yi ge 'di bzhin byung ba yin te/ ༈ /rgya nag ral gri 'bar ba kun gyi rje/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta shrī singha'i 'od zer 'phros pas sa dkar po'i yul gyi dge bshes kun dga' ming can de la zlo ba/ gdug 'dres sngon chad stag gzig dom dred kyi pags pa dgos byas pa 'phral du byung pas dga' rab yin/ snying dang 'dra ba'i ban chung de phyi ma'i snang ba shar bar de tsam gyi sems nad byed mi dgos/ dge bshes kyi smon lam gyi rgyas btab kyis dag pa'i zhing khams su skye bar the tshom med kyang rung / dge bshes sngon chad kyi drag thal can nas nye bar bzung / sa dkar po'i dge bshes na rim gyi lag g.yog tu dus phyis 'byung gi bar du skye ba yang nas yang du len pa sa de kha'i 'khor du yong ba yod pas/ dge bshes rang gis ngos 'dzin pa bgyis/ dge bshes rang gi thog tu skye bas lag g.yog tu phan pa byed do zhes chos skyong rang gi gsung shog tu 'khyon pa dang /

de'i gsal byed mkhan tshangs pa'i yi ger// ༈ //yig chung phul 'bras/ phyag mdzod bde gshegs kyi sku skye ba bzhes tshul/ chos skyong chen po'i phebs sgor/ dge bshes drag thal can de sngags 'chang chen po yin 'dug pas/ de'i thugs bskyed smon lam gyi 'phen pa'i de dus kyang sku lus la gcar ba'i phyag g.yog yin zhing / de nas smon lam dbang gi da res kyi skye ba 'di the bas skye ba gnyis blangs/ da dung yang smon lam dbang gis dag bshes na rim gyi dge bshes re dang lag g.yog re spel gyin yod pas da dung yang mang na skye ba bdun dang lnga/ mtha' na'ang skye ba gsum len pas dge bshes kyis nges par gyis /dge bshes rang gi smon lam gyi 'phen pas dag pa'i zhing du skye ba blangs kyang skye ba dbang thob phyin ma dag pa'i zhing du skye ba la dka' las ci yod/ dge bshes rang gis kyang dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing du skye ba ji tsam blangs gdug 'dres ri mor 'khod zin pa min pa e yin/ sa yul ni dge bshes rang gi sa nas shar lho'i nub byang gi sar ha cang 'byor pa ma ches shing / ha cang dbul ba ma yin pa'i snyoms po ya rabs sngar nas kyang dge bshes kyi lag g.yog gi rigs byung pa'i sar lo ngo 'di 'phos pa'i gting ma'i sgang tsam la skye ba len shas che ba/ pha ma gang rigs sam de'i nye 'khor du gtogs pa gang rigs la rtags shig yong ba yod/ gang ltar gdan sa chen po rang gi cha zhabs khul du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i/ zhabs drung rin po che sku nyid rang gi sku tshe 'di rang la phyag phyir 'gyur ba yong bas/ slar gdug pa 'dre la 'tshar dga' sbyin chog pa byed do gsung ba phebs byung ba/ rnam mkhyen mchog gi dbyings bzhugs pa mkhyen mkhyen zhes pa'i mkhan tshangs pa'i gsal byed kyi yi ge dang bcas pa 'byor byung pa nas/ yun ring ma lon pa'i skabs shig nged rang gi yid snang la rab 'byams pa de pa tshang rang la deng sang mngal zhig skye rgyu yod las che snyam/

de bzhin yod med kyi dri rtog rang dang nyer gnas bsod nams rab brtan la bgyis pas/ sngar bdag gis gang yang ma shes/ slar dri rtog byed dgos pa 'dug zer/ de nas spun rnams dang 'phros byas pas mjal yod nges su 'dug pa'i kha skad go byung bas /nged kyi bsam pa la sngar chos skyong chen po'i lung bstan la chos gzhis kyi khongs su skye ba yong ba byed gsungs pa de thog tu khel ba yin nges snyam bca' kas thon pa sogs pa'i bkod pa byas shing / de nas dus la babs pa'i tshe gegs med du btsas byung ba na/ de 'phral sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i drung du rab 'byams smra ba de nyid kyi skye ba yin min gyi brtag pa byas pas /yin tshul bzang chug tu byung zhing / de bzhin chos skyong chen por yang lung bstan zhu mi btang pas/ de'i lan gsung shog rgyas pa'i nang na deng sang yang dge bshes kyi snying dang 'dra ba'i ban chung de bde ba can dang u rgyan sogs dag pa'i zhing rnams su phar 'gro tshur 'gro mang po byed/ skabs 'gar dge bshes rang gi rtsar yang 'khor tsam 'khor tsam yong ba sogs skye ba la dbang thob pas sprul sgyur gang yang zhig byed kyin 'dug tshul gyi bsngags brjod che ba zhig gnang 'dug cing / de'i yig chung na/ gdug 'dres sngon chad sa yul der dge bshes rang gi lag g.yog lde mig gi bkod pa byed mkhan de/ phyi ma'i snang ba shar ba'i dus su bkod pa dang bstun pa'i bde ba can gyi zhing khams sam/ nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul gang rigs su 'khyol ba zhig dgos zer byung bar/ gdug 'dres dge bshes rang gi lag g.yog tu 'gyur ba zhig nye skor du yong byas pa de/ khye'u chung de la the tshom gyi bkod pa byed dgos pa med do/ /nges par gyis/ nges par gyis/ nges par gyis zhes pa'i chos skyong rang gi gsung shog dang / de'i gsal byed mkhan tshangs pa'i yi ge na/ phyag mdzod rin po che de nyid kyi sku skyes snga mor nas lung bstan gnang ba'i sku nye'i sar 'khrungs pa de ka 'khrul med yin phebs pa'i bstan pa spel nus shig yong ba yod pas gtsang sbras gang thon gyis gsung byung ba rnam mkhyen mchog gi dbyings su bzhugs pa mkhyain zhes pa'i yi ge rnams bsam yas 'byor byung pas/

bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rjes/ chos skyong rnams kyis 'phrin las bsgrubs te/ mi shi gson mi 'phrad zer ba yang mi bden pa'i dpes/ ya mtshan ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas su 'dug snyam pa shar/ byis pa 'di btsas 'phral sngar chos skyong chen po'i lung bstan la/ de rang gi pha ma'i nye 'brel gyi sar rtsub 'gyur gyi rtags mtshan phran bu byung tshul phebs pa de yang sgra ji bzhin byung song bas yid ches pa'i gnas su byung ngo / /de skad 'di yang dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /lhag bsam dag pas sa skya'i bla chen dang / /snang ba mtha' yas gnyis kyi gser zangs sku/ /gsar du bzhengs pa'i gzungs gzhug bzhugs tshul dang / /de las 'phros pa'i yi ge rgyas pa 'di/ /sa skya'i lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang du/ /lcags yos khrums zla'i dkar po'i tshes kyi nyin/ /gza' skar bzang po 'dzoms tshe sbyar ba yi/ /yi ge pa ni sa skyar skyes pa yi/ /rnam dpyod blo ldan nor bu lha sbyin no/ /'di sbyar dge dang dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring ba'i/ /mthar thug gyur nas bstan pa cher rgyas shing / /phyi ma kun kyang dag pa'i zhing 'dzoms nas/ /sprul pas srid mthar bstan pa spel gyur cig /rtsa brgyud bla ma rin chen dkon mchog gsum/ /yi dam chos skyong nor lhar bcas pa yi/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan rnams kyi thugs rje'i mthus/ /sngar bzhin don kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis byon/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/ thams cad bkra shis/ mastu sarba dza gattaṃ/ skye dgu thams cad dge legs su gyur cig shu bhaṃ// dge'o// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ lha khang chen mo'i gser sku sku tshad ma dang 'od dpag med kyi sku gnyis kyi gzungs gzhug gi dkar chag PAGE
